chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Enters the Grand Dao Domain! The Three-Foot Sword Awakens – Desolate Era Chapter 277
chapter_meta_description: Pressured by Shaoyan Nong and Xiangliu Fang, Ji Ning achieves a legendary breakthrough to the Grand Dao Domain of the Sword, forging a Sword Soul and unleashing the Sixth Stance of the Three-Foot Sword.
og_title: The Sword Soul Ignites! Ji Ning Unleashes the Sixth Stance of the Three-Foot Sword
og_description: Forced into a corner, Ji Ning’s Dao-heart undergoes a fundamental transformation, allowing him to step into the Grand Dao Domain and slaughter his foe in a single, devastating strike.
twitter_title: The Sixth Stance 'Grand Dao Domain' is unleashed!
twitter_description: Ji Ning’s sword-light fills the hall, cutting down Xue Hongyi and shocking Shaoyan Nong. A legendary breakthrough in a life-or-death crisis!

lore_anchors.definition: A state of enlightenment where a cultivator’s soul aligns with one of the supreme Grand Daos, projecting a field of absolute influence. It is far harder to achieve than an ordinary Dao Domain and represents a qualitative leap in a cultivator's soul and power.
One of the exalted Grand Daos, renowned for its supreme offensive power. Entry is marked by the formation of a Sword Soul and grants the title of Sword Immortal.

A legendary nine-stance sword art created by Immortal Beixing. The first six stances are passed down via scripture, but the final three can only be transmitted through a direct Sword Immortal inheritance. Each practitioner manifests the stances uniquely.
The form of a Sword Immortal’s divine soul after reaching the Grand Dao Domain of the Sword. The soul itself transforms into a sword, sharpening the cultivator’s will, perception, and attack power.
A primordial Fiendgod from the ancient Xiangliu clan; his combat power rivals that of a top-tier Loose Immortal, and he serves as Shaoyan Nong’s powerful bodyguard.
The Wanxiang Adept and former Snowdragon Mountain agent who betrayed Ji Ning’s information to Shaoyan Nong; he is killed by Ji Ning’s breakthrough strike.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Grand Dao Domain (大道域境)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a state where a cultivator's soul and comprehension align with a Grand Dao (like the Dao of the Sword), allowing them to project a field of absolute Dao influence. For a Sword Immortal, it means their soul transforms into a 'Sword Soul', and every attack becomes imbued with the Dao's power.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is Ji Ning’s breakthrough such a big deal?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because he is still at the Wanxiang Adept level. Achieving a Grand Dao Domain is so difficult that even many Primal Daoists and Celestial Immortals fail to do it. It marks Ji Ning as a monster-class genius and fundamentally changes the quality of his soul and sword-art.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Three-Foot Sword (三尺剑)?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the highest sword-art inheritance of the Black-White College, created by the legendary Immortal Beixing. It is not a fixed set of moves but a philosophical guide that helps a Sword Immortal develop their own unique sword techniques.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Can anyone learn the Three-Foot Sword?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The first six stances can be learned from scriptures, but the final three stances require a direct 'Sword Immortal inheritance'—a spiritual resonance between the teacher and the student that can only occur when the student is worthy.
